Local landscaping

Landscaping in Wilton, for acreage and new estates alike

Wilton is not a standard suburban grid. You have larger rural-residential blocks, bush-fringe boundaries and newer estate releases, and each needs a different plan. Acreage often means managing slope, access and larger planting; new-estate blocks mean turnkey landscaping to design guidelines.

We come to you, walk the block, and quote a fixed price with no call-out fee. One licensed team handles design through to maintenance.

Get your fixed-price quote

props.label: Built for Wilton blocks
props.html:
Why Wilton is different

Built for Wilton blocks

Acreage and rural blocks

Larger Wilton properties need planting, paving and retaining planned around access, slope and how much yard you actually want to maintain. We scale the design to suit.

Bushfire-fringe planning

On bush-backed Wilton boundaries we plan defendable space: low-flammability planting away from the house and non-combustible hardscaping close in. Check your BAL rating with the RFS and council.

New-estate handover

Building in a Wilton release like Bingara Gorge? We deliver turnkey front and back packages that meet estate design guidelines and landscaping bond conditions.

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Wilton: your questions answered

Do you landscape acreage and rural blocks in Wilton?
Yes. Larger blocks are a big part of Wilton, and we plan them around slope, access and maintenance so the finished yard suits how you live, not just how it looks on day one.
Can you landscape a bushfire-prone Wilton block?
Yes. We plan defendable space with low-flammability planting and non-combustible hardscaping close to the house, working to the intent of Planning for Bush Fire Protection. Confirm your BAL rating with the RFS and Wollondilly Council.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
